title: RunOverrides
description: data/running/owner/run-overrides.yaml: per-run owner changes (FR-049/050). List files carry no schema_version; they are always the current version.

items.title: RunOverride
items.x-error: needs at least one change besides id

hide.description: Hidden runs are not published at all.

exclude_from_records.description: Ignore this run for PBs and goals (e.g. a GPS glitch).

include_in_records.description: Make a treadmill/indoor run eligible for PBs and race-time goals (FR-057). Published as the run's flags.include_indoor_in_records.

is_race.description: Designate the run as a race (or not).
